scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2164 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

grimsel-pass.story: A 62 km one-way ride from near Meiringen, about 1 h 04 of riding. It goes by way of Handeck, Grimsel Hospiz and Grimsel Pass. The highest point is about 2,350 m. Grimsel Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
